description:
About the Role   

 iCapital is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Business Process Analyst, UiPath Developer to join our Intelligent Automation team. The ideal candidate will combine solid business analysis skills with hands-on UiPath development experience to identify, design, build, and deploy Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions that drive operational efficiency across the organization.   

 Responsibilities   

 
 Engage with business stakeholders to identify, document, and prioritize automation opportunities. 

 Conduct process discovery workshops and prepare detailed Process Definition Documents (PDDs). 

 Perform AS-IS and TO-BE process mapping; calculate ROI and feasibility for automation candidates. 

 Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications for development. 

 Design, develop, test, and deploy automated workflows using UiPath Studio (REFramework preferred). 

 Build attended and unattended automation bots using UiPath Orchestrator for scheduling and monitoring. 

 Integrate RPA solutions with enterprise systems including ERP, CRM, and legacy applications. 

 Conduct unit testing, UAT support, and defect resolution throughout the development lifecycle. 

 Maintain and enhance existing automations to address process changes or system upgrades. 

 Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including Solution Design Documents (SDDs) and runbooks.     

 Adhere to CoE standards, coding conventions, and change management procedures. 

 Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development best practices. 

 
 Qualifications   

 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, business administration, or related field 

 3+ years of hands-on experience in business process analysis or RPA development 

 Proficiency in UiPath Studio, UiPath Orchestrator, and UiPath Assistant 

 Experience developing automation using REFramework and exception-handling best practices 

 Solid understanding of process analysis methodologies (BPMN, swimlane diagrams, value stream mapping) 

 Familiar with at least one enterprise platform (SAP, Salesforce or ServiceNow) 

 Working knowledge of SQL, Excel automation, and API and web service integrations. 

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and verbal and written communication skills 

 UiPath Certified RPA Associate (UiAR) or UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) 

 Experience with AI/ML capabilities in UiPath (Document Understanding, AI Fabric, Action Center) 

 Exposure to process mining tools such as UiPath Process Mining or Celonis 

 Agile and Scrum project experience, CBAP or PMI-PBA certification is a plus 

 Problem solving and analytical thinking

 Communication and stakeholder management

 Attention to detail

 Team collaboration

 Adaptability and learning agility

 UiPath automation tools

 AWS cloud services

 Python, VB.NET/C#, API integrations

 SQL databases

 Git, Docker, JIRA, Confluence

 REST/SOAP services and Postman

 Microsoft Power Platform

 Process Mining (UiPath/Celonis)   

 
 Benefits   

 The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $120,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).   

 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.    

 For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/   

 iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
